Name: Prismatic Fire - Continued - Gems and Minerals (CP)
Author: recon88
Description:
[size=5]Overview[/size]
[size=2]This is an addon for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30814]PrismaticFire - Continued[/url] and provides fire colors for all available gems and materials.


[/size][size=5]Use[/size][size=2]
Simply rightclick a fire with an item that is listed in the [b]content.json[/b] file or below.
The fire will then change it's color.
